No, we cannot. According to **Purchase Policy §6.2** (and **Supplier Policy §4.1**), parts that come into contact with food—such as gaskets—may be bought **only** from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Price is not an exception to this rule.

According to Rasoi's **Purchase Policy §6.2** and **Supplier Policy §4.1**, parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in the item master) **may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate** on file in Bahi. 

The certificate must be uploaded and checked **before the first order** is placed.
